'''''The Bell of Silence''''' is Book One of the [[Aurefold (series)|Aurefold]] series.

{{Quote|In the high silent valleys, a goatherd hears a voice. House Whitehart exists to test those who claim to hear.}}

It begins with a testing. In [[the Light Heights]], a goatherd named [[Sela]] hears a voice — or does not. The testing falls to [[Brother Tomas]], the Tester; above them both stands [[Mother Alaine]], fifty years at the griffes, head of the listening house. The book is told in three movements, threaded with three interludes in Mother Alaine's voice. In the second movement a herald of [[House Blackcrest]] comes to stay in the valley, gathering the realm's testimony for [[The 400-year jubilee|the coming jubilee]].

The book opens with the [[Chronicle of Victory]]'s account of the swearing of the [[Ash Oath]] — and with a marginal note in an unidentified hand: ''Count the seals.''
